main.job: order food or drink (Spain, bar and restaurant)
main.why: the default way to order in Spain; unlocks every order

main.job: say which dish is yours when ordering in a group
main.why: heard and said at every table order

main.job: ask for a table for N people on arrival
main.why: the arrival act; mesa is known, sitio is the natural word

main.job: ask the waiter for a recommendation
main.why: core ordering act when you don't know the dishes
needed to start any request mid-meal

main.job: ask for a dish without something

main.why: the reaction to food; estar not ser

main.job: understand the waiter asking if you want anything else
main.why: heard after every order; must be understood and answered

main.job: ask whether something is possible or allowed here (pay by card, sit outside)
main.why: unlocks paying by card and other requests

main.job: pay for someone else's food or drink (treat)
main.why: the paying act among friends; te invito / invito yo is everywhere in Spain

spares.job: polite way to say what you want when ordering
spares.why: second most common ordering frame in Spain

shape.notes: usage slice: noun limit off. menú, mesa, camarero and la cuenta are known and are used freely. No closed sets started; courses (de primero/de segundo/de postre) skipped as a set that would take 3 slots.
